name: Treasure Island
bio_draft: Island resort: a marine reserve island with palm beaches, snorkelling, a turtle restoration programme and family facilities.

name: South Sea Island
bio_draft: Island resort: a 30-minute day trip from Denarau with a pool, snorkel gear, kayaks and a semi-submersible coral viewer.

name: Bounty Island
bio_draft: Island: a marine-reserve island (Bounty Island, Kadavulailai) with white beaches, a small resort and snorkelling.

name: Cloudbreak
bio_draft: Surf break: the headline reef wave off Tavarua, a world-class right in the southern Mamanucas (no article of its own; Wikipedia Cloudbreak redirects to Tavarua).

name: Sawa-i-Lau Caves
bio_draft: Cave: limestone sea caves on Sawa-i-Lau islet off the southern tip of Yasawa Island, swum into by boat trip (one reached by an underwater passage, daylight in the largest cave); the cave trip Wikivoyage lists under Do. Tourism board page seen in search only (fetch blocked).

name: Blue Lagoon
bio_draft: Beach and snorkel lagoon on the west side of Nanuya Lailai, the film location of The Blue Lagoon (1980); a fish sanctuary with coral, reached on Blue Lagoon Cruises day trips. Wikivoyage: the real Blue Lagoon is privately owned, this is the day-trip beach. No article under this name (the title is a disambiguation page), so views are 0 and a disambiguated wiki title is still needed.
